say:4:1028209001:1.text: Oh wind, I implore you to heed my voice... share with me the wisdom of all things...
say:4:1028209001:1.source_cn: 风啊，我请求您倾听我的声音……带给我万物的讯息……

say:5:1028209002:1.text: I think this is how the Windwhisperers speak to the wind...
say:5:1028209002:1.source_cn: 风语者是这样和风对话的吧……

say:6:1028209003:0.text: But why can't I hear its voice? Have I done something wrong?
say:6:1028209003:0.source_cn: 但是，为什么听不到风的声音……是我哪里做得不对吗？

say:13:1028210001:1.text: Do you think if he feels he can hear the wind, he'll go back to the academy?
say:13:1028210001:1.source_cn: 你说，如果他听到风的声音，是不是就愿意回学院了？

say:14:1028210002:0.source_cn: 满满终于说了一句聪明话！

say:15:1028210003:0.text: Hmm... Chippy has an idea! Magister, can you summon a wind elemental for him?
say:15:1028210003:0.source_cn: 唔……嗯，有了！主人，拜托你为他召唤一只风元素好不好？
say:15:1028210003:0.male: Hmm... Chippy has an idea! Magister, can you summon a wind elemental for him?
say:15:1028210003:0.female: Hmm... Chippy has an idea! Magister, can you summon a wind elemental for him?

say:16:1028210004:1.text: If we summon one, he'll think the wind answered his call! Maybe then he'll go back to the academy.
say:16:1028210004:1.source_cn: 风元素出现，也算是他的交流成功了吧！也许这样他就能安心...

choice_prompt:17:1028210004.text: If we summon one, he'll think the wind answered his call! Maybe then he'll go back to the academy.
choice_prompt:17:1028210004.source_cn: 风元素出现，也算是他的交流成功了吧！也许这样他就能安心回学校去了？

say:22:1028210005:0.text: Look! Randy sees the wind elemental!

say:23:1028210006:0.text: He looks so happy! Now he can go home!
say:23:1028210006:0.source_cn: 他看上去很高兴！嘿嘿，这下他该心满意足了吧！

say:26:1028211001:0.text: It's the wind! You heard my call, didn't you?
say:26:1028211001:0.source_cn: 风……是风！你……你听到我的召唤了，对不对？

say:27:1028211002:1.text: Amazing! Misarte really gave me the power to speak with the wind!
say:27:1028211002:1.source_cn: 太棒了！弥萨忒真的赐予了我风语天赋！

say:28:1028211003:1.text: Could you please pass a message to my mama and papa? Just say that I can talk to the wind now. When I grow up, I will become the best Windwhisperer...
say:28:1028211003:1.source_cn: 请你传个信息给我的爸爸妈妈好不好？就说……对，就说我现...

say:29:1028211004:0.text: ...Hmm? Why is the wind blowing so strong? Please wind, heed my words, and calm down...
say:29:1028211004:0.source_cn: ……嗯？怎么风越来越大了，风啊，聆听我的话语，请你不要...

say:33:1028211005:0.text: Why does Chippy feel the wind elemental isn't very happy...
say:33:1028211005:0.source_cn: 满满怎么觉得风元素有点不太高兴……

say:34:1028211006:0.text: He can't speak to the wind at all. The elemental doesn't understand what's going on and may think it's being provoked!
say:34:1028211006:0.source_cn: 糟了，他根本不会风语。这样“沟通”，风元素可能会觉得他...

say:36:1028211007:0.text: What's happening? Listen! Please listen to me!

say:39:1028211009:0.text: Oh no, the wind elemental is going berserk! Quick! Let's go!
say:39:1028211009:0.source_cn: 不好，风元素狂暴了！快、快阻止它！

narration:41:10282223:0.text: Randy notices the wind elemental you summoned and looks delighted.
narration:41:10282223:0.source_cn: 兰迪看到了你召唤出来的风元素，似乎非常高兴。

narration:42:10282222:0.text: You and Chippy, along with Hammie, anxiously observe Randy from a distance.
narration:42:10282222:0.source_cn: 你和满满、漫漫藏在不远处，担忧地观察着兰迪。

narration:43:10282221:0.text: Upon reaching a clearing, Randy arranges the ritual once again.
narration:43:10282221:0.source_cn: 兰迪来到一片空地上，再一次布置好了仪式。
